MikroTik RB450Gx4 – High-Performance 5-Port Gigabit Ethernet Router

The MikroTik RB450Gx4 is a powerful, compact, and energy-efficient router designed for enterprise networking, ISP applications, and advanced routing solutions. Featuring a quad-core ARM processor, 5 Gigabit Ethernet ports, and IPsec hardware acceleration, this high-performance board is ideal for secure and efficient network management.

Key Features 

  • Powerful Quad-Core Processor – Equipped with an IPQ-4019 CPU (448-896 MHz, auto-adjusting) for fast and reliable performance.
  • 5 x Gigabit Ethernet Ports – Ensures high-speed data transmission and seamless connectivity for enterprise networks.
  • RouterOS License Level 5 – Unlocks advanced routing, firewall, VPN, and bandwidth management features.
  • High-Capacity RAM & Storage – 1GB RAM & 512MB NAND storage for efficient data processing and smooth performance.
  • IPsec Hardware Acceleration – Enhances VPN encryption speeds, ensuring secure remote access and data protection.
  • Multiple Power Input Options (DC & PoE-IN) – Supports 10V-57V input via DC jack or PoE, offering flexible deployment options.
  • Passive PoE-Out on Port 5 – Provides power to other PoE-compatible devices, reducing cable clutter.
  • Industrial-Grade Durability – Withstands extreme temperatures (-40°C to 70°C), making it ideal for harsh environments.

Technical Specifications

  • Model: RB450Gx4
  • Architecture: ARM 32-bit
  • CPU: IPQ-4019, Quad-Core, 448-896 MHz
  • RouterOS License: Level 5
  • RAM: 1GB
  • Storage: 512MB NAND
  • Operating System: RouterOS
  • MTBF: ~100,000 hours at 25°C
  • Power & Energy Efficiency
  • DC Inputs: 3 (DC Jack, PoE-IN)
  • Voltage Range: 10V - 57V
  • Max Power Consumption: 16W (4W without attachments)
  • PoE-IN Support: 802.3af/at (12-57V)
  • PoE-Out on Ether5: Passive PoE (Max 500mA output)
  • Networking & Connectivity
  • Ethernet Ports: 5 x Gigabit Ethernet (10/100/1000 Mbps)
  • Memory Card Slot: microSD for storage expansion
  • Serial Console Port: RS232 for advanced configurations
  • Environmental & Compliance
  • Tested Ambient Temperature: -40°C to +70°C
  • Cooling System: Passive (fanless operation)
  • Certification: CE, EAC, ROHS

Ideal Applications

  • Enterprise Networking – Provides secure, high-speed connectivity for corporate offices, data centers, and cloud applications.
  • ISP & WISP Deployments – Supports advanced routing, VPN, and bandwidth management for internet service providers.
  • Secure VPN & Firewall Applications – Built-in IPsec acceleration ensures fast and secure VPN tunnels.
  • IoT & Smart Infrastructure – Works well in industrial and outdoor environments with extreme temperature resistance.
  • Advanced Home Networking – Ideal for enthusiasts and professionals seeking a high-performance home router.

Why Choose the MikroTik RB450Gx4?

  • High-Speed, Gigabit Performance – Powerful quad-core CPU ensures smooth network operations.
  • Flexible Power Options (DC & PoE-IN) – Supports multiple power inputs for versatile deployments.
  • Secure & Reliable – IPsec acceleration and RouterOS Level 5 license provide top-tier security features.
  • Compact, Energy-Efficient Design – Fanless cooling and low power consumption for efficient operation.
  • Rugged & Durable – Withstands extreme temperatures, making it ideal for harsh environments.
